events.catalyst_description: Broadcom Inc. reported its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2026 (ended August 2, 2026), including net revenue of $29.6 billion (up 86% year-over-year), GAAP diluted EPS of $2.68 and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $3.32, GAAP operating income of $16.0 billion and non-GAAP operating income of $20.1 billion, and free cash flow of $13.7 billion.

surprise.evidence_span: Revenue of $29.6 billion for the third quarter, up 86 percent from the prior year period

events.catalyst_description: Broadcom's CEO stated that fiscal Q3 2026 AI semiconductor revenue was $16.7 billion, up 221% year-over-year and 54% quarter-over-quarter.

surprise.evidence_span: Q3 AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7 billion grew 221% year-over-year, and 54% quarter-over-quarter

events.catalyst_description: Broadcom issued its business outlook for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026 (ending November 1, 2026), guiding to revenue of approximately $34.8 billion (an increase of 93% from the prior year period) and non-GAAP operating income of approximately 66% of projected revenue.

surprise.evidence_span: Fourth quarter fiscal year 2026 revenue guidance of approximately $34.8 billion, an increase of 93 percent from the prior year period

events.catalyst_description: Broadcom's CEO guided fiscal Q4 2026 AI semiconductor revenue to accelerate to approximately $21.7 billion, up 236% year-over-year.

surprise.evidence_span: In Q4 the momentum continues, and we expect AI semiconductor revenue to accelerate to $21.7 billion, up 236% year-over-year.

events.catalyst_description: Broadcom's Board of Directors approved a new quarterly cash dividend of $0.65 per share, payable September 30, 2026 to stockholders of record as of September 21, 2026.

surprise.reference_source: Broadcom's previously paid quarterly dividend of $0.65 per share, paid June 30, 2026, as stated elsewhere in this same document
surprise.evidence_span: The Board of Directors of Broadcom has approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.65 per share. The dividend is payable on September 30, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business (5&#58;00 p.m. Eastern Time) on September 21, 2026.

events.catalyst_description: The document states that Broadcom already paid a quarterly cash dividend of $0.65 per share, totaling $3.1 billion, on June 30, 2026 (the prior quarter's dividend payment).

surprise.evidence_span: On June 30, 2026, the Company paid a cash dividend of $0.65 per share, totaling $3.1 billion.

unsupported_claims_noted: GAAP diluted EPS of $2.68 (+215% YoY per the financial highlights table), GAAP operating income of $16.0 billion (+171% YoY), non-GAAP operating income of $20.1 billion (+92% YoY), and free cash flow of $13.7 billion (46% of revenue) are all reported in the release as part of the same Q3 FY2026 results disclosure as the revenue figure; they were not extracted as separate event objects because they are different accounting presentations of the same single quarterly-results announcement rather than distinct economic propositions, not because a supporting span could not be found.

The document discloses cumulative common-stock repurchases under the repurchase program of $(8,450) million for the three fiscal quarters ended August 2, 2026, and a dash (zero) for repurchases in the current fiscal quarter, but only inside a structured cash-flow-statement table with no accompanying prose claim. This was not extracted as a standalone buyback_or_capital_return event because there is no clean, unambiguous evidence span tying a plain-language claim to that number without crossing extensive table markup, and the current-quarter figure shows no actual repurchase activity.

The statement that 'the Company's cash and cash equivalents at the end of the fiscal quarter were $24.0 billion, compared to $19.6 billion at the end of the prior fiscal quarter' was not extracted as an event because a period-end cash balance does not correspond to any of the listed event categories.

The document does not restate what revenue, EPS, or operating-income guidance the company itself previously issued for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 (only year-over-year percentage changes against the prior-year period are given, with no explicit prior-year dollar figure stated in prose), so no earnings_surprise event comparing Q3 actual results to the company's own prior guidance could be constructed with a valid reference_value/reference_source.

Mentions of 'VMware' and 'acquiring VMware' occur only inside generic forward-looking-statements risk-factor boilerplate (e.g., 'potential tax liabilities as a result of acquiring VMware' and 'integrating acquired businesses with our existing businesses') and do not state any new or specific acquisition/divestiture fact in this document, so no acquisition_or_divestiture event was extracted.

No customer, supplier, or counterparty company is named anywhere in this document (a full scan for capitalized company-name patterns found only 'Broadcom Inc.'), so no supply_agreement, customer_agreement, order_win, order_loss, or entity_relationship could be extracted.
